readStrip: LiSN read 386 partner and installer interactions this week, about 77 a working day, across email, help desk, service calls and Salesforce. 13-week history: 4,940.
brief: Delivery promise slipped for three distributors in {{region:North}}; one issue we fixed in June is back; installers report extra set-up time on network configuration.

pulse.title: What's critical
pulse.body: {{region:North}}: promise kept 71% against its own 88% over 4 weeks. 3 distributors, 46 order lines, 2 projects facing a fire NOC inspection.

pulse.title: Where's your focus
pulse.body: Licence re-activation after a laptop change is back for the third time since the June fix. 11 contacts this week.

pulse.title: What's stable
pulse.body: Installers keep praising ease of programming: 22 mentions this quarter, steady. {{region:South}} and {{region:West}} promise kept on target.

questionCards.title: Are we keeping our promises?
questionCards.insight: Most {{region:North}} misses trace to one allocation queue, not supply. Other regions ship the same product family on time.

questionCards.title: What keeps coming back?

gauges.label: Themes with a fix on record

questionCards.insight: Three fixes did not hold. Each is linked to what was done last time.

questionCards.title: What do installers experience?
questionCards.insight: Installers describe about 25 extra minutes on network set-up. Most first-line feedback sits with partners and is not connected yet.

signals.title: North promises slipping
signals.recommendation: Re-prioritise allocation for the 2 inspection-bound projects; send each distributor one confirmed date.

signals.title: Last-mile delays, {{place:Gurugram hub}}
signals.topIntent: Local delivery lag after hub arrival
signals.recommendation: Open a last-mile review for the {{place:Gurugram hub}}.

signals.title: Licence re-activation, back a third time
signals.recommendation: Update the knowledge article and confirm the portal change with the US product team.

signals.title: Order status asked on the help desk, not the order desk
signals.recommendation: Refresh the auto-reply with a clearer order-desk path.

signals.title: Network configuration adds set-up time
signals.recommendation: Share a one-page set-up guide with partners; send a feedback note to the US product team.

notConnected.name: Partner email with builders and sites

sources.footnote: Richer installer voice sits with partners. See Partner view.

loopClosureStrip: This quarter: 11 issues closed with a confirmed fix · 3 came back after a fix · promise kept (all regions) up 6 points since August, {{region:North}} the exception · same-day replies to partners 52% → 64%.
